detail.title: Investigating Mechanisms of Observer Divergence
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates research into the structural causes of persistent observer disagreement. While internal predictive processing models suggest that observers calibrate observations against individual contexts, we seek further evidence on how these mechanisms manifest in scientific and philosophical discourse, potentially explaining why rigorous observers can derive differing conclusions from shared phenomena. We are prioritizing the collection of literature regarding observer disagreement to build a synthesis-ready framework.
